1606 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 05-30: May has 31 days, so days remaining in May = 1 (May 31 only).  
June 30 days, July 31, August 31, September 30, October 31, November 30, December 31.  
Add sequentially:  
222 days = 1 (May) + 30 (June) + 31 (July) + 31 (Aug) + 30 (Sep) + 31 (Oct) + 30 (Nov) + 18 left = Dec 18.  
Thus new date is 1606-12-18.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1606-12-18
